plan.notes: Official MCC catalog page 'Business Administration (A.S. Degree) | Program Requirements' (MCC Program Code BU01, CIP 52.0201), transcribed verbatim 2026-10-09. Page carries no explicit catalog year; it is marked 'Revised: 03/10/2026' and is the current published program page — filed as 2026-2027 (current) and disclosed. Entrance requirement: MCC Level 6 Mathematics Placement. Credit ranges resolved at MINIMUM credits with disclosure (plan prints 61-65 total; this plan sums 61). Semester totals: 14 + 16 + 16 + 15 = 61. Footnotes transcribed: (*) Students should check with their advisor to determine the appropriate choice for Mathematics. (**) COS 101 may be subbed with COS 133 (or other program-specific college success course previously completed). (***) Students should consult with advisor or intended transfer institution to determine whether to take BUS 204 or BUS 208. (****) Students whose math placement is level 7 or lower will use the open elective for MTH 104 - Intermediate Algebra; students who place level 8 and above should consult with their advisor to choose an appropriate elective. NOTE: MCC's older department program page for the same degree prints a DIFFERENT, older sequence totaling 60-62 credits; this seed follows the current official catalog page (revised 03/10/2026), which supersedes it. 100% of this program can be completed online.
